quests.crisisScene: A man was in a bicycle accident. He has a bleeding scrape on his elbow and says his chest hurts when he breathes deeply. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Assume emergency services are already on their way without verifying.
Move a victim with a potential spinal injury abruptly to sit them upright.
REPORT THE CHEST PAIN AS THE PRIORITY
quests.correctAnswer: REPORT THE CHEST PAIN AS THE PRIORITY
quests.explanation: Chest pain with breathing could mean a rib or lung injury, which matters far more than a surface scrape.

quests.crisisScene: The same man's chest pain gets sharply worse and he starts breathing fast and shallow. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: UPGRADE THIS TO THE HIGHEST URGENCY
Send an informal email to customer service and go about your daily routine.
Throw cold water directly onto an active electrical or grease fire.
quests.correctAnswer: UPGRADE THIS TO THE HIGHEST URGENCY
quests.explanation: Sharp pain with fast, shallow breathing can mean a collapsed lung, so the call needs to be treated as top priority immediately.

quests.crisisScene: A different accident victim has a twisted ankle and a small graze, with no other complaints. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Tell the affected individuals to calm down and walk away without rendering aid.
REPORT IT AS LOWER PRIORITY, STILL WORTH A CHECK
Confront armed suspects alone while shouting threats.
quests.correctAnswer: REPORT IT AS LOWER PRIORITY, STILL WORTH A CHECK
quests.explanation: Without a symptom that threatens something vital, this can be treated as lower priority while still deserving medical attention.

quests.crisisScene: A man's speech has suddenly become slurred and one side of his face is drooping. Input medical code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Wait until tomorrow morning to see if the situation resolves itself naturally.

CALL FOR AN AMBULANCE AND NOTE THE START TIME
quests.correctAnswer: CALL FOR AN AMBULANCE AND NOTE THE START TIME

Attempt invasive emergency surgery on the spot using unsterilized kitchen utensils.
quests.correctAnswer: REPORT THE BEST ESTIMATE, DON'T GUESS EXACTLY
quests.explanation: An honest estimate is far more useful to doctors than a falsely precise time that could lead to the wrong treatment decision.
